note: Steps written by hand from the footage (102 s phone video of a yellow Sun King solar lantern: dome close-up, pick-up and turn-over, solar panel reveal, wire-stand fitting, standing demo). The audio track is very quiet and was not transcribed, so there is no transcript; timestamps come from observed actions. Positions come from hand-observed box centres and are placeholders until a 3D model is captured and calibrated.

steps.action: Look over the lamp at rest
steps.instruction: Look over the lamp: the dome faces up and the button sits on the side.

steps.action: Pick up the lamp and turn it over
steps.instruction: Pick up the lamp and turn it over in your hand.
Turn the back out so the solar panel faces the light.
Fit the wire stand onto the lamp body.

steps.action: Stand the lamp on its stand
steps.instruction: Stand the lamp on the wire stand with the panel facing out.

title: Sun King solar lantern set-up
